issues.issue: Governmental beginning/ending (1,070,506 / 1,314,843) are modified-cash fund balances (they include due to/from other funds; fund-level cash + investments is 2,080,212), but they are stored as beginning_cash/ending_cash instead of beginning/ending_fund_balance. The roll-forward ties exactly. The figures are right; only the field label is in question.

issues.on_page: Other supplies and expenses 15 (Debt Service Fund)
issues.issue: A 15 supplies/expenses line is recorded as debt interest. This is defensible because the governmental funds statement (p4) includes it in 'Interest and other charges' 53,759 (= 53,744 + 15).
The page doesn't name the intergovernmental source; 'rural fire district' is the extractor's assumption.

Printed as Miscellaneous with no breakdown, so 'other' is acceptable, but it is 23% of governmental receipts (>10%). Street Fund Miscellaneous 104,699 (p10) equals the Street Fund's Investments 104,699 on the fund balance sheet (p3), so it may be an investment reclassification rather than revenue. The Statement of Activities (p2) shows Miscellaneous general revenue of only 168,925.
